source_defined_nodes.definition: Presented video image frame I_t and sequence I_0:T-1, external stimulus at experiment boundary
Lower-level latent r_t; estimate rhat_t distinguished from predicted rbar_t
Higher global latent r^h representing within-sequence transition dynamics; inferred/updated online, not a fixed learned matrix
Spatial synthesis matrix U generating mean image U r_t
Finite learned lower-level basis matrices V_1..V_K, K=5 in main two-level experiments
Hypernetwork H_theta and its persistent weights theta
w=H_theta(r^h), top-down predicted modulation coefficients; neither higher latent itself nor independent learned basis
V=sum_{k=1..K} w_k V_k; effective per-sequence/per-inference lower-level transition
rbar_t=ReLU(V rhat_{t-1}) for t>=1; no same-form temporal input at first frame
Image prediction U r_t and predicted image from prior state U rbar_t distinguished
Spatial residual e_s(t)=I_t-U r_t; negative log likelihood weighted ||e_s||²/(2sigma²)
Temporal residual e_tau(t)=r_t-rbar_t; weighted ||e_tau||²/(2sigma_r²)
Laplace-like lower sparsity λ||r_t||_1 and higher Gaussian-prior penalty λ_h||r^h||²
L_t sum of spatial error, temporal error, lower sparsity, higher prior; initial L0 excludes temporal term
Within-sequence gradient/MAP update rhat_t given observations and past rhat; at each step also update r^h to reduce L_t
Across-sequence/time parameter optimization of U,V_k,theta minimizing residual objective after latent-state inference
Generative distributions p(r^h) Gaussian, p(r_t|rprev,rh) Gaussian, p(I_t|r_t) Gaussian; latent r sparse penalty
Approximate previous posterior as point MAP delta; approximate higher posterior p(rh|I0:t) by unconditional p(rh); r^h one global latent per sequence despite changing online estimate
Model neuronal activity as latent estimates, weight as parameters, apical top-down gain/basal recurrent effects as proposed possible pyramidal implementation
Natural-video training sequence 65,520 non-overlapping 16x16 10-frames whitened (58,968 training/6,552 test); Moving MNIST 10k 18x18 10-frames 9k/1k
Natural video learned V1-like separable/inseparable STRFs; higher response autocorrelation slower: natural 5.49 vs 2.18 frames, white noise 3.11 vs 0.18
Moving MNIST r^h encodes motion direction and lower r more digit identity; 73.9% vs 46.5% direction, 20.9% vs 76.1% identity
Flash-lag synthetic Moving MNIST 134 sequences, with/without trajectory, continuation/stop/reversal/flash; neural-model correction inner-iteration sampling 10% vs 90%
Model prediction early along prior path and late corrected postdictive reversal under reversal, qualitatively compared with separately published human psychophysics
Associative memory latent m, distinct from r^h and distinct from primary DPC state
Memory synapses G generate sbar=Gm of concatenated content/dynamics s=[rhat_0;rhat^h]
Memory encoding MAP m then separate G plasticity on ||s-Gm||²+λ_m||m||² while pretrained base DPC weights frozen
Recall uses cue-masked partial lower initial r0; mask excludes missing r^h from residual; predicted stored dynamics drives full lower-level sequence
Recall from start cue strong after conditioning, mid weak, end none; comparisons are model activity versus external existing biological reports
Three-level distinct r^(1)_t lower, r^(2)_t intermediate, r^(3) top with top-level estimating second-level transition type
Two separate pre-trained V^(2)_1,V^(2)_2 for straight and clockwise bouncing and learned H_theta^(2) top-down network
w^(2)=Htheta2(r3), V^(2)=sum w2_k V2_k, predicted rbar2_t=V2 r2_{t-1}
Binary b_t from FIRST-level prediction error > post-hoc training-set threshold (rho reported 0.73 in in-article S1 description); second-level transition prediction term active only when b_t=1
Three-level discriminates straight vs clockwise bounce sequence after first bounce and encodes higher-order sequence transition class
Biological neural hierarchy and hippocampal coupling are hypotheses/comparisons motivated by experiments, NOT directly measured proof of model neuronal mechanism

temporal_orders: V2: rhat_(t-1) and current inferred rh -> w=H(rh) -> V weighted -> rbar_t predicted -> I_t externally presented -> spatial/temporal errors -> iterative r_t and rh inference -> next t
Within-learning: latent inference within each sequence precedes/accompanies parameter-gradient accumulation for U,V_k,theta across sequences/time; not identical update state
VF: same discrete t after reversal: initial prediction using earlier estimates -> early 10% gradient trajectory -> later 90% error-corrected postdictive trajectory; no milliseconds time mapping
VM optional: pretrained DPC encodes estimates -> memory m inference -> G updated 5 times with DPC weights fixed -> later partial-cue retrieval m -> rh replay and inferred sequence

V3: two transition bases pretrained with distinct bounce types -> later three-level Htheta2 learning; low-level error exceeds b threshold -> r2 transition -> error corrects r3 -> stabilize r3 when learned class fits

limits.text: K=5 used; more lower matrices gave no significant improvement in authors' analyzed case; supporting Fig A only described in PDF
No hardcoded longer time constant or smoothness constraint for higher r^h; stability learned via model
MAP Dirac previous posterior and unconditional prior approximate p(rh|history); not exact full Bayesian filtering
Flash-lag simulation synthetic stimuli and relative correction iterations, compared qualitatively with separately collected human experimental phenomena
Memory extension separately added with new persistent G and latent m; trained DPC parameters frozen
Memory cue order empirical simulation: start strong, mid weak, end absent
Two-level sequence-global r^h lacks direct representation of higher-order between-sequence bounce-type transition; three-level required for that task
Alternative additive/concatenative top-down parameterization said theoretically equivalent; claimed hypernetwork param advantage conditional not universal
Three-level error threshold post-hoc training-set estimate; future online precision learning not part of reported model
Possible added dependence of second-level transitions on position/spatial context discussed as future, not implemented
Natural video nonstationarity weakens autocorrelation estimator assumptions; deterministic MAP prevents exact Murray et al neural trial-variability method
Neural gain on apical dendrites, hippocampal episodic memory analogy, cortical timescales are model interpretations and comparisons, not direct tests of those mechanisms
